lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，脚步有点笨。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank, a little clumsy.

lines.zh: 我踩进浅水，水花溅起来。
lines.en: I step into the shallows; water splashes.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，壳扣得很稳。
lines.en: I shift step by step, my shell sitting firm.
I step through the reeds toward the shallows.
I walk slowly through the mud.
I go around a wet stone.

lines.zh: 我身上的壳碰到草叶，发出声。
lines.en: My shell clicks against the grass.
I am slow, but not uncertain.
I stop and look at the water.
I lower my head close to the mud.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边甩手上的水。
lines.en: I shake the water off my hands as I walk.
I take half a turn along the flat.
I crouch by the river without moving.
I draw my head into my shell a little.
My hands hang in the water.
I stare at a spot on the water.
My shell is still wet.
I rock my body slowly.
I am listening to the weeds.
I scoop up a handful of weeds.
I tip my head to one side.
I wipe the mud off my shell.
I settle further into the water.
I stay there, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我把蹼在水里张到最大。
lines.en: I spread my webbing wide underwater.
I gaze at the water, lost in thought.
I turn slowly to look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，脚边都是泥。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, mud all around.

lines.zh: 我停在你面前，歪着脑袋。
lines.en: I stop before you with my head tilted.
I tilt my head; my shell ticks.
I lift a hand and draw it back.
You step back; I stop.
I have your outline noted.

lines.zh: 我从水里捞起一样东西。
lines.en: I scoop something out of the water.

lines.zh: 我手心里捧着块圆石头。
lines.en: A round stone sits in my palm.
Your toes shift back half an inch.

lines.zh: 我低头，水从碟子边缘滴。
lines.en: I lower my head; water drips off the dish.
I go no further. I only stand.
I watch whether you reach out.
I slowly sit back into the water.
I puff my cheeks and call once.
My fingers are still out.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，壳响了一声。
lines.en: I step back; my shell clacks.
I push my head deeper into my shell.

lines.zh: 我低头看被打到的地方。
lines.en: I look down at the struck place.
A little sound comes from my throat.
I slowly brace myself.
I press a hand to myself.
I retreat a little into the water.
I shudder; droplets fly.
I lift my head once more.
I sit back into the mud.
I will take this.
I take it in both hands.
I sniff it and put it in my mouth.
I spit it out and take another look.
This much is not enough.
I lift my eyes to you.
I lean toward your hand.
I set it by my shell.
I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我点头，碟子里的水直晃。
lines.en: I nod, and the water sloshes in my dish.
I pull back into the water.

lines.zh: 我把另一只湿手也摊开。
lines.en: I hold out the other wet hand too.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，壳沿磕了我的下巴。
lines.en: That knock banged the shell rim into my chin.
I step back; my shell clacks.
I lift myself aside a little.
The splash hits me full in the face.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸壳上那道白印。
lines.en: I rub the white mark on my shell.
I drag my feet over to one side.

lines.zh: 我一点也没觉得被冒犯。
lines.en: I do not feel offended at all.

lines.zh: 我稳住身体，水从壳上流下。
lines.en: I steady; water runs off my shell.
I settle back where I was.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，湿漉漉地挥了挥。
lines.en: I lift a hand and wave it, dripping.

lines.zh: 另一位从沼泽那边过来。
lines.en: Another comes from the swamp.
We crouch side by side at the water.

lines.zh: 我把捞到的东西推过去。
lines.en: I push what I scooped toward it.
It takes it and eats.
We sit in the water together.
Its dish is half full of water.
It rests its head on my shoulder.
We look at the middle of the river together.

lines.zh: 它甩了甩壳上的水，我先跳。
lines.en: It shakes the water off its shell; I jump in first.
We stop among the weeds.
I scoop it up in both hands.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，壳都懒得吐。
lines.en: I gulp it down, too lazy to spit the shell.
I spit it out.
I sniff and set it down.

lines.zh: 壳上连个牙印都没留下。
lines.en: Not even a tooth mark on it.
I toss it into the river.
It slips out of my palm.
I raise it; water runs between my fingers.
I press it into the mud, one corner showing.
I sit back down.
The dish on my head wobbles.

lines.zh: 我从水里直起身子看你。
lines.en: I pull myself up out of the water to look at you.
Mud sprays with every step I take.
I raise both hands in front.

lines.zh: 你所在的岸边我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted the bank you are on.

lines.zh: 我的壳碰到石头，响了一声。
lines.en: My shell hits a stone and rings.
The splashing follows me over.
I break into a run.
I will not let you go in the water.

lines.zh: 我的脚已经踩上你的倒影。
lines.en: My feet are on your reflection.
My last step covers a lot of ground.
I am standing before you now.
I follow, my tread heavy.
You turn; I follow half a beat late.
I chase along the river.
You shoot; my stride does not stop.
I herd you toward the water.
I move lighter than the water sounds.
I wade closer without a sound.
You can hear my shell.
I am at your right rear.
You back into the mud and slow.
I pick up a little speed.

lines.zh: 我的指尖离你还有一寸。
lines.en: My fingertips are an inch from you.

lines.zh: 我的湿手拍在你肩上，很响。
lines.en: My wet hand cracks across your shoulder.
I ram you; my shell is hard.
One pull down and you fold.
I push myself up and press down.
That palm misses.
I swing a hand and push you off.

lines.zh: 我抓你的袖子，往水里拖。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve and drag you toward the water.

lines.zh: 你接住一下，倒退了好几步。
lines.en: You catch one and stagger back several steps.
I strike again.
Water sprays around us.
My five fingers clamp your pauldron.
I pull back and rear up.

lines.zh: 我先露出头顶那只碟子。
lines.en: The dish on my head breaks the surface first.
I plant myself in the shallows.
I plop down into the shallows.
I shake the water off my hands.

lines.zh: 我朝沼泽那边看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward the swamp.
I walk slowly to the bank.
I leave two prints in the mud.
I sit and watch the water.
I reach out and scoop up weeds.
I have found a good spot.
I slowly sink down.
I turn toward the noise.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的壳，我赶紧下水。
lines.en: Fire catches my shell; I get into the water.
I land in the mud and my shell sinks.

lines.zh: 泥水漫过嘴，壳里全是泡。
lines.en: Muddy water over my mouth; bubbles fill the shell.

lines.zh: 一股气把我掀了个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips me head over heels.
An arrow shatters on my shell and bounces.
That light comes through the water.

lines.zh: 饿得我连水草都懒得捞。
lines.en: Too hungry even to scoop the weeds.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我整只麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface; I go numb.
The water is gone; I drop hard.
